Subject: ACME POC Kickoff - Scope, Metrics, and Next Steps

Hi Jordan and Priya —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Wanted to capture the key takeaways and the agreed next steps so we have a single reference as we kick off the POC.

Summary of business goals / pain:
- Reduce latency for customer-facing assistant responses to under 200ms p50 for short form queries (<= 64 tokens).
- Cut per-conversation inference cost by ~35% without degrading relevance for top-3 answers.
- Improve intent classification accuracy for support routing to >= 92% on your evaluation set.

POC scope (what Redwood will deliver):
- Deploy a dedicated POC instance (private project) using Redwood Dedicated compute with a tuned model variant and quantization profile.
- Provide a prompt set of 500 labeled examples (we'll seed with 200 from ACME + 300 synthetic/augmented prompts by Redwood).
- Implement KV-prefix caching for repeated customer flows and automated batching config.
- Run weekly quality evals and a final evaluation against the ACME holdout set.

Success metrics / acceptance criteria:
- Latency: p50 <= 200ms, p95 <= 350ms for target query mix.
- Cost: per-conversation inference unit cost reduced by >= 30% vs current baseline.
- Quality: Top-3 relevance maintained within 3% absolute of baseline; intent classifier >= 92% accuracy.

Timeline / owners:
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff and infra access (owner: Jordan + Acme IT)
- Week 1: data & prompt handoff, initial model config (owner: Marissa / Aditya)
- Week 2-3: integration + early evals (owner: Aditya / Rishi)
- Week 4: optimization pass, final eval, wrap & next-steps (owner: Marissa / Jordan)

Access / setup steps we need from ACME this week:
1) A single API key or temporary read-only S3 access for the labeled prompt set (contact: it@acmecorp.com)
2) A representative sample of 5k anonymized support transcripts (redacted) for prompt tuning
3) Confirmation of the target SLA window (timezone/peak hours) and expected query volume (qps)

Action items (agreed on call):
- Jordan: share S3 path or API key by EOD Tuesday (Jul 17) — will include point-of-contact at Acme IT.
- Priya: confirm procurement timeline and any PO constraints (Procurement copied).
- Marissa / Aditya: share the POC plan doc and access checklist (attached) by tomorrow.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (POC scope & config), access-checklist.csv (fields needed from Acme IT).

If that all looks right I'll create the HubSpot milestone and schedule the Week 1 integration slot in the calendar.

Thanks — excited to get started.
—
Marissa Cole
